title: More Tailscale tricks for your jailbroken Kindle
summary: This article explores creative ways to run Tailscale VPN on a jailbroken Kindle e-reader, demonstrating different TUN modes and proxy configurations to extend networking capabilities beyond the device's original design.
problem_solved: Enables VPN connectivity and secure networking on a Kindle e-reader for proxy and remote access purposes.
why_valuable: Demonstrates creative hardware repurposing and shows Tailscale's versatility running on unconventional embedded devices.
